name: Shamma (Son of Reuel, grandson of Esau and Bashemath)
title: Edomite tribal chief
summary: Shamma was a son of Reuel and a grandson of Esau and Bashemath (Ishmael's daughter). He became a tribal chief in the land of Edom and represents one of the Edomite clans descended from Esau. His lineage shows the connection between the families of Esau and Ishmael.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Reuel's lineage
keyEvents.description: Shamma is listed as one of the sons of Reuel, who was a son of Esau and Bashemath, in the genealogy in Genesis.

keyEvents.title: Shamma as a tribal chief in Edom
keyEvents.description: Shamma was appointed one of the tribal chiefs (alufim) among the descendants of Reuel in the land of Edom.

keyEvents.title: Part of Esau's lineage
keyEvents.description: Shamma belongs to Esau's broader lineage that settled in the mountains of Seir, the area known as Edom.

keyEvents.title: Repeated in Chronicles
keyEvents.description: Shamma's name is also preserved in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles as part of Esau's descendants.
